purpose: Publish an evidence-first Hugging Face Community discussion for the completed RTX 4070 Ti study.

target.title: Qwen3.8-27B on an RTX 4070 Ti 12GB: IQ2 vs Q2, 16K context, and MTP

publication_requirements: Every headline performance, context, quality, and MTP claim links to its public GitHub evidence.
Measured facts remain separate from interpretation and limitations.
The report identifies Q3 and Q4 as deferred rather than implying missing results.
The report does not claim general model quality, arbitrary 16K capacity, or transparent MTP equivalence.
The public repository passes the full offline test suite and strict release audit before submission.
excluded_actions: uploading runtime archives or local logs
creating a Hugging Face model, dataset, or Space repository
running Docker or a hosted inference deployment
creating or moving the Git v0.1.0 tag

current_public_state.github_actions_result: passed on Windows with Python 3.11 and 3.14

final_gate.reason: Creating the discussion is public representational communication from the authenticated Hugging Face account.
